about.statement: I design, build and test robotic systems, from surgical robots to machines that cut rock and concrete
bio: I’m Liam, a Senior Mechatronics Engineer at Rockslice in Bergen, Norway, where I work on robotic rock and concrete cutting.
From 2019 to 2023 I was a mechanical engineer at Ethicon and Auris Health (Johnson & Johnson), designing, testing and integrating subsystems for a laparoscopic surgical robot.
I hold an M.Sc. in Mechatronics from MCI Innsbruck and a B.Sc. in Aerospace Engineering from Cal Poly San Luis Obispo.
Outside work I enjoy overhung crimp boulders, ski touring, and most of all: robotics.
